It's really disheartening as the surgery is very welcoming and the staff are kind. Unfortunately I still haven't been able to get an appointment for my medical concerns, as the online form closes so quickly and I'm not in a position where I can sit on my phone refreshing the website waiting for it to open. The boys will always take priority.

When I eventually got appointments for my sons, they were on different days whereas before they would try and have the GP see us all together. It's a lot to expect a 2.5 year old and baby to sit in the surgery for prolonged times (as both visits were behind schedule) twice in a week. It's also not very fair on the other patrons.

I'm now in a situation where my son requires a follow up appointment and I'm unable to have someone sit with the boys until the school holidays.

This system is terrible. Please bring back the option to phone in the AM and PM.
